Sandbox_DynamicEvents_StudioModerator_to: Let KIPN Moderators open the Event Studio from the right-click menu and build, start, announce, cancel and simulate events. Admins always can.
Sandbox_DynamicEvents_StudioStaff_toolti: Let KIPN Staff open the Event Studio from the right-click menu and build, start, announce, cancel and simulate events. Admins always can.
Sandbox_DynamicEvents_StudioGM_tooltip: Let KIPN Game Masters open the Event Studio from the right-click menu and build, start, announce, cancel and simulate events. Admins always can.
Sandbox_DynamicEvents_StudioObserver_too: Let KIPN Observers open the Event Studio from the right-click menu and build, start, announce, cancel and simulate events. Admins always can.
Sandbox_DynamicEvents_SimulationModerato: Moderators online can be invited to join an event simulation. They choose OK to be taken to it or Cancel to stay out. Admins can always be invited.
Sandbox_DynamicEvents_SimulationStaff_to: Staff online can be invited to join an event simulation. They choose OK to be taken to it or Cancel to stay out. Admins can always be invited.
Sandbox_DynamicEvents_SimulationGM_toolt: Game Masters online can be invited to join an event simulation. They choose OK to be taken to it or Cancel to stay out. Admins can always be invited.
Sandbox_DynamicEvents_SimulationObserver: Observers online can be invited to join an event simulation. They choose OK to be taken to it or Cancel to stay out. Admins can always be invited.
